transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm just here because I can't seem to slow down. Since I stopped working, it's like... I don't know, I'm just always up and moving from one little job around the house to the next. All day. Kind of like I still have a crew waiting on me to get things done.
During this time, have you been feeling unusually high or irritable?
No... I wouldn't say that. I don't feel high or anything. And I'm not really angry either. Just... like I said, I just keep moving. That's about it.
Have you been needing less sleep than usual?
No, not really. I sleep about the same as I always have. Just regular sleep.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about things?
No, not especially. I mean... everyone worries a little, I guess. But it's not taking up my whole day or anything.
Do you feel driven to keep doing these tasks even when you don’t want to?
No, not really. It's not like that. I just... do them. I don't feel forced or anything.
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted?

I suppose. Like... if I'm trying to paint, or maybe plan out a story. If I hear a truck outside, or just think of something out in the garden... my mind kind of jumps right over there. I just lose where I was. That's about it.
Have you been this easily distracted for most of your life?

I suppose. Yeah. Um... even back in grade school, I guess. My teachers used to tell my parents I was... bright, but scattered. Always losing my pencils. Or... calling out answers, things like that. They were always having to remind me to finish my work before recess. So... yeah, it's been a while.
